verdict.rationale: Airwallex's Bills API supports creating and managing vendor invoices, and Transfers/Batch Transfers can pay vendors, but the evidence only shows bill creation/management via API with no documented approval-workflow feature (multi-step sign-off, approval routing/thresholds) tying bill upload to a payment gate. missing for 10: explicit approval workflow/routing configuration, UI for finance-lead to upload bills and route for approval, evidence of approval status blocking payment execution.
